title: Legacy Journal Migration Adapter with Safe Derivation Rules
problem: Migrating legacy journals lacking required fields risks fabricating false certainty or crashing replay.
proposed_change_boundary: Implement formal derivation rules: default safe task_version=1; HOLD missing goal_id; UNKNOWN missing start-time.
known_risks: Corrupt legacy records will be placed on HOLD, requiring operator inspection.
stop_condition: Execution of any legacy task whose goal_id was fabricated.
